mechanics.fact: Isp can hold STEADY to brake the receiving ferry. The light sac travels through the duct and onto/off the ferry; DELIVERY is a minWeight-2 pad that can be powered by one hero plus the sac while the other rides the signal bridge. The bridge requires power; Cana's nearest-target throw can push the sac or a hero.

common_mistakes.mistake: The light sac misses the ferry or is knocked into the gutter.
common_mistakes.consequence: DELIVERY loses the cargo weight and the bridge stays unpowered.
common_mistakes.recovery: Source hint says retrieve the sac from the gutter if needed, then route it back to the ferry/DELIVERY; cost is extra traversal, not a demonstrated reset.

confidence_reason: Source supports the weight/pad sequence and an ordinary scripted route completes. Captures are selective snapshots; no novice decisions, mistakes, or human control reliability are observed.

confirmed: Cargo, ferry and partner bridge are central.
missed_mechanics: STEADY brakes receiving ferry; DELIVERY has minWeight 2 and can be hero+sac; signal bridge is remote and powered; sac can be recovered from gutter.
Boomerang commits to nearest hero when its aim begins, and can nudge light cargo.
incorrect_inferences: Pass-one did not know the exact order/weight rule; any assumption that the projectile itself is lethal would be unsupported.
changed_judgments: Reasoning/cooperation stay 3/3; execution rises 2->3 because the sac must be routed through the duct/ferry while the partner rides the powered bridge. Timing/hazards resolve from unknown to 1/0 (repeatable aim warning, no authored lethal hazards). Novelty rises 2->3 because the earlier light-cargo, two-weight, ferry, and targeting lessons are combined into remote delivery. Recovery resolves to 2 because the source specifies gutter retrieval, though its traversal cost is not measured. Clarity stays 3: the visible 2x2 delivery cue helps, but it omits the cargo route and remote partner role.
unresolved: Whether players infer which hero should hold DELIVERY while the partner rides.
Exact consequences and time cost if cargo drops or is pushed off the ferry; only an authored recovery hint and one successful scripted route exist.

single_operator_note: A solo operator must alternate cargo pushing, pad occupancy and bridge riding; the switching is outside the two-human baseline.
